title: 第8章 拒绝加入唐门，建立天使殿，震慑
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“啊？为什么？”

唐雅傻了，她是真的没想过这样的条件眼前的师徒会拒绝，尤其是她看雨浩小弟弟眼中对唐门和史莱克学院的向往不是假的，怎么会拒绝呢？

可她不知道站在她眼前的是谁，若是旁人被她唐雅这样忽悠，说不定就这样稀里糊涂的加入了。

可对方是千仞雪啊！

在一听到她是唐门门主时，没直接拔剑将她两人砍了，已经是她仁慈了。

这可是万年前覆灭她武魂殿的主力之一！

如今她们两人能站在这里，还要多谢他们告诉她唐门已经没落了，只剩下这两歪瓜裂枣，大大消灭了她的杀意。

冤有头债有主，千仞雪可以只针对唐三和史莱克七怪，但唐门它休想再次崛起！

也休想让她师徒加入！

不过这个理由肯定不能说，因此——

“因为我们有自己的宗门了。”

“哦，是这样吗？那不好意思了，不过能问问你们的宗门是?”

“天使殿！“

武魂殿肯定暂时不能用了，以这个时代被唐三洗脑的状态，只要她现在提及武魂殿，一定会引起反感，虽然这两人的反感与她而言什么都不是，但她怕麻烦，她还需要慢慢融入这个时代，于是转念一想，给出了宗门名。

“天使殿？怎么没听说啊？”

唐雅低声喃喃，就连贝贝都皱眉想了许久，两人确定都没听说过。

“没听说过很正常，因为这个宗门目前只有我师徒二人。”

唐雅：“.......”

贝贝：“........”

唐雅和贝贝实在不知道怎么说了，因为他们是真的没想到，整个宗门只有两个人这种事还能碰到一样的，真是有缘啊！

可霍雨浩则不是那么认为的。

他用一秒便接受了老师建立的天使圣宗，转而声援自己的老师。

“对，但这只是目前这样，我老师很厉害的，若是真的全力发展宗门，一定很快就壮大了！”

得到自己徒弟的全力支持，千仞雪很满意。

“徒儿说的不错，饿了吗？去找吃的去？”

“好。”

Page (1/3)

"Ah? Why?"

Tang Ya was dumbfounded. She really never thought that the master and apprentice in front of her would refuse such a condition, especially when she saw that the yearning for Tang Clan and Shrek Academy in younger brother Yuhao's eyes was not fake. How could she refuse?

But she didn't know who was standing in front of her. If others were deceived by Tang Ya like this, they might just join in without realizing it.

But the other party is Qian Renxue!

When she heard that she was the head of the Tang Sect, she didn't draw her sword and kill them both. It was already a mercy of hers.

This was one of the main forces that destroyed her Spirit Hall ten thousand years ago!

Now that the two of them are standing here, they must thank them for telling her that the Tang Sect has declined, and only these two crooked melons and jujubes are left, which greatly eliminated her murderous intention.

Qian Renxue could only target Tang San and the Shrek Seven Devils, but the Tang Sect could never rise again!

Don't even think about letting her master and apprentice join!

But I definitely can’t say this reason, so——

"Because we have our own sect."

"Oh, is that so? I'm sorry, but can I ask which sect you belong to?"

"Angel Palace!"

Wuhun Palace must be unusable for the time being. With the state of being brainwashed by Tang San in this era, as long as she mentions Wuhun Palace now, it will definitely arouse resentment. Although the resentment of these two people is nothing to her, she is afraid of trouble. She still needs to slowly integrate into this era, so she changed her mind and gave the name of the sect.

"Angel Palace? Why haven't you heard of it?"

Tang Ya murmured in a low voice, and even Beibei frowned and thought for a long time. They were sure that neither of them had heard of it.

"It's normal that I haven't heard of it, because there are currently only two masters and disciples in this sect."

Tang Ya: "......"

Beibei: "......"

Tang Ya and Beibei really didn't know what to say, because they really didn't expect that there were only two people in the entire sect and they would meet the same person. What a fate!

But Huo Yuhao didn't think so.

It took him only a second to accept the Holy Angel Sect established by his teacher, and turned to support his teacher.

"Yes, but this is just the way it is now. My teacher is very powerful. If we really go all out to develop the sect, it will definitely grow stronger soon!"

Qian Renxue was very satisfied with the full support of her apprentice.

"My disciple is right. Are you hungry? Are you going to find something to eat?"

"Okay."
